section.p: The Vibration X FFT (vibxFFT) is the vibration amplitude measured in the tangential direction of the motor. This recorded data is the result of the FFT transformation with the vibration signal X, in the unit of decibels (dB).

li.p: Each record contains an FFT of the vibx samples captured on the specified timestamp.
It is necessary to generate the corresponding X-axis data to plot this vibxFFT data in a graphic. The X-axis data is a vector of 7,500 data points with a step of 0.41667 Hertz (Hz).
The following two datasets, Vibration Z FFT (vibzFFT) and magnetic field FFT (fluxFFT), also use the same time stamp to generate the FFT graphic. All 3 datasets, vibxFFT, vibzFFT
